About this reconstruction

Files are decoded on your device. The software renderer supports PS1 polygons, lines, rectangles, palettes, texture windows, transparency, dithering, masks and VRAM transfers.

This is an inspection renderer, not a cycle-accurate emulator. Rasterization edges, cache feedback and interlaced / 24-bit display behavior can differ from DuckStation.

The geometry explorer uses screen coordinates and optional draw-order depth. GPU dumps cannot recover the original 3D camera, hidden surfaces, or world coordinates.

Supports legacy DuckStation v1 and standard v1r1 dumps, raw or Zstandard compressed. XZ files must be decompressed first. Limit: 64 MB decompressed / 100,000 GP0 commands.
